title: 20th sitting of the 19th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/19/2024).
Approval of the minutes of two previous sittings (minutes Nos. 14/2024 and 15/2024).
Bills to be introduced: first reading of the bill to amend the Employment Act (Law No. 2/2008), submitted on behalf of the government by Kulhudhuffushi North MP Mohamed Dawood.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the bill to amend the Maldives Legal Profession Act (Law No. 5/2019), submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhumalé North MP Hussain Shareef.
Committee business: report of the General Committee on its work compiling the Standing Orders (rules of procedure) of the 20th People's Majlis.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting introduced an Employment Act amendment, continued debating the Legal Profession Act amendment, and took up the General Committee's report on the new Majlis Standing Orders.
